LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_TurretAttackMana: Automatically attacks detected enemies. Each attack consumes {0} mana.

LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_Terraform: Periodically improves nearby terrain into more fertile ground.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_SeedlingGrowthBonus: Increases the growth speed of adjacent arcane plant seedlings by {0}.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_Glow: Emits light nearby while mana is active.

LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_GlowStarlit: Blooms at night or in space, lighting its surroundings.

LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_HeatAbsorb: Absorbs heat while mana is active. (down to {1})

LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_Battery: When wired to a power network, stores up to {0}Wd of power.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_LightningRod: When unroofed and mana is active, attracts natural lightning strikes and increases nearby environment mana by {0}.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_SeedlingRandom: Grows into a random arcane plant when fully grown.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_Everflower: Vivis can perform attunement rituals to raise its resonance level, unlocking various rituals and abilities.
LanguageData.VV_PlantFunction_EverflowerTeleport: When attuned, can teleport to a designated location.
